summary: Successfully implemented readOnly(IsolationLevel) method for MeteredKeyValueStore class in Apache Kafka. Created a custom MeteredReadOnlyKeyValueStoreView inner class that wraps the underlying store's read-only view with metering and serde functionality. The implementation applies serialization/deserialization for keys and values, and records metrics for all read operations (get, range, reverseRange, all, reverseAll, prefixScan). All 43 tests in MeteredKeyValueStoreTest pass, including 9 new readOnly-related tests.
